build_gt_occupancy: build GT occupancy from a ground truth point cloud and return batched occupancy grids with visibility masks
get_fused_gt_feat: compute fused ground truth feature volumes by back-projecting image features into voxel space using depth maps
get_feats_world: extract world-space point clouds and aligned target features from a batch of ARIA sensor data and camera calibrations
compute_tv_loss: compute the total variation loss across depth, height, and width dimensions of a batched occupancy grid
compute_occupancy_loss_subvoxel: compute subvoxel occupancy loss by sampling free, surface, and occupied points with support for l2, l1, ce, and focal loss types
